statement: ∃ (b : Module.Basis (Fin (l+1)) ℤ M) (c : Module.Basis (Fin (l+1)) ℂ V), (∀ i, (b i : V) = c i) ∧ Submodule.span (LR.R p) (Set.range c) = LR.MR p M
proof:
classical
rcases h_H004.1 with ⟨ι, b₀, c₀, hc₀⟩
rcases h_T003.2.1.1 with ⟨ec, hec⟩
let e : ι ≃ Fin (l+1) := c₀.indexEquiv ec
let b := b₀.reindex e
let c := c₀.reindex e
have hc : ∀ i, (b i : V) = c i := by
  intro i
  simpa [b, c] using hc₀ (e.symm i)
refine ⟨b, c, hc, ?_⟩
apply le_antisymm
· apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [← hc]
  exact Submodule.subset_span (b i).property
· apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  intro m hm
  let m' : M := ⟨m, hm⟩
  have hs : (∑ i, (b.repr m' i) • (b i : V)) = m := by
    exact_mod_cast b.sum_repr m'
  rw [← hs]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro i hi
  apply Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem
  rw [hc]
  exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i)

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (K : Type) [fieldK : Field K] (l : ℕ) (V : Type) [addV : AddCommGroup V] [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V]
  (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ l < p →
    ((∃ ι b c, ∀ (i : ι), ↑(b i) = c i) ∧
        ∀ (r : ℕ), (∀ (m : ↥M), (LR.divided x r) ↑m ∈ M) ∧ ∀ (m : ↥M), (LR.divided y r) ↑m ∈ M) →
      LR.N1 l x y h v → ∃ b c, (∀ (i : Fin (l + 1)), ↑(b i) = c i) ∧ Submodule.span (LR.R p) (Set.range ⇑c) = LR.MR p M
